conviction_note: A small negative lean: Belc publishes no monthly sales, so the Jun-Aug quarter is genuinely unseen, but the only evidence on it is a proxy (Kanto peer comps no better than in Q1, when Belc's operating profit fell 15%). The one item the release can add is a cut to the range guidance, and the street (OP 18,300) already sits near its 18,000 low end. Findings sum to -0.9. The scaled number is (2*0.45-1)*3.5 = -0.35, smaller because the uncertainty about the sign goes into p_up, while the findings are sized one at a time.
bar: Constructed, not a published H1 consensus: the kabuyoho analyst consensus for FY ordinary income is 18,500m yen (OP 18,300m; 2 analysts; unchanged for 4 weeks; https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9974). Applying last year's H1 progress of 49.4% gives an implied H1 ordinary income of about 9,140m yen. My H1 estimate is about 8,200-8,400m yen (Q1 3,426m plus a Q2 of about 4,800-5,000m against 5,028m a year earlier). The company range is OP 18,000-19,800m / OI 18,200-20,000m (Q1 tanshin https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/99740/140120260710590938.pdf). Because the H1 bar is constructed, every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin: 信用倍率 5.37x on 10/02, margin longs 18.8k shares against shorts 3.5k (kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9974). findings.finding: H1 operating profit is likely down about 9-12% YoY (about 7,800-8,100m yen against 8,884m), a progress of about 43-45% of the 18,000m low end against 49.6%/52.8%/63.8% at H1 in the last three years. Q1 already missed the internal sales plan (OP -15%, same-store sales +0.1%, customers -1.4%, SG&A ratio +0.7pt), and Kanto peer comps for Jul/Aug 2026 were no better than in Mar-May (USMH -0.5%/-0.3%, Kasumi -2.3%/-2.5%, Marue­tsu -0.2%/-0.1%, Yaoko +2.7%/+2.5%), against last year's rice-boosted H1 when Belc's same-store sales were +6.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 on 2026-07-10 (14:00 release, OP -15%, 'sales below plan'): -4.6% from the open to the next close. H1 FY25 on 2024-10-10 (OP -2.3%, 'on plan'): +6.3%. H1 FY26 on 2025-10-09 (OP flat to slightly down): -0.9%. Computed from Yahoo daily bars https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9974.T?range=3y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: Belc publishes no 月次, so Jun-Aug is not visible the way a monthly reporter's quarter is. But Q1's miss and its 18.8% progress are public, and the stock has already given back about 7% from the September high. If the market expected a flat H1, the stock would not be trading at 10.5x the company's low-end EPS with a 'sell' trend signal. So this is only partly unpriced.
findings.independence: Peer monthly comps, a different source: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s092979.html (Aug, 2026-09-29) and https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s083174.html (Jul, 2026-08-31). Heiwado H1 OP -17.1% citing rice price competition: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/accounts/s100116.html. These are a proxy, not Belc's own numbers.

findings.finding: The forecast decision is what the release adds. Street OP 18,300m / OI 18,500m sits just above the bottom of the company's 18,000-19,800m range. To hold the low end after an H1 of about 7,900m, H2 has to reach about 10,100m (+12% against last year's H2 of 9,016m, which itself rose 13%). Belc has made no H1 forecast revision in FY25 or FY26 (its last revision was an upward one at Q3, January 2024), so holding or narrowing is the base case, and a cut below 18,000m is the tail that would move the stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Belc's only recent revision, the January 2024 upward revision with Q3 (https://irbank.net/9974/ir): -2.6% from the open to the next close. Its first range guide on 2026-04-10: -3.1%. No downward revision at H1 in the irbank record back to 2016.
findings.why_not_priced: The street number has not moved in four weeks (18,510 to 18,500) despite Q1's -14% ordinary income, so it has not marked the H2 that the low end requires. If a cut were priced, the street would sit below 18,000m and the stock would not have bounced to 7,050 in September. If the range is held, that is consistent with the street and gives at most a small relief rally, which is why this finding is sized slightly negative rather than at the cut's full -3 to -5.
findings.independence: Peer Life held its full-year plan on 10-08 and said H2 rice-comp headwinds ease (https://www.ryutsuu.biz/accounts/s100815.html), which argues for a hold. That is evidence for the positive side and is why the cut is treated as a tail rather than a base case.

searched_and_found_nothing: Event date: confirmed 2026-10-09 on kabutan (決算発表予定日 2026/10/09) and kabuyoho (中間決算 2026/10/09). No separate 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 filed before the print (irbank TDnet list https://irbank.net/9974/ir, latest filing 2026-07-31).
月次 / same-store sales for Jun-Aug 2026: Belc does not publish them on TDnet, and belc.co.jp IR resets connections from curl. The kitaishihon IR mirror carries only reports and 有報.

Shareholder returns: the H1 dividend is fixed at 66 yen in the plan (payout policy about 20%). The last H1-time dividend raise was October 2023 (stock -3.8% that day). No buyback history. The 優待 was expanded in November 2025 as a standalone filing. Nothing points to a return action today.
Stock split: the 2026-05-20 投資単位 notice is boilerplate under listing rule 409 ('慎重に検討'). No split signal.

Financing: the 2026-07-31 20,000m yen commitment line is a disaster-contingency backstop with an impact the company calls 軽微 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/99740/140120260731504329.pdf). It buys nothing that bears on this print.
四季報 autumn 2026 forecast for Belc: not reachable. Only kabuyoho's 2-analyst consensus was found.
Major shareholder: FMR at 10.00% (2026-03-09 notice). Nothing new since.

Returns: none expected (dividend fixed at 66/132). New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 18.8% against 21.9% a year earlier; H1 is likely about 43-45% of the low end against 49.6% / 52.8% / 63.8% in the last three years.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Peer Life held its FY plan on 10-08 with H1 ordinary income on plan; Belc rose 1.5% this morning
rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the guidance finding as evidence for the hold case. The morning move is already in the sealed spot.
The document itself states the purpose is disaster contingency with a 軽微 impact on earnings, so reading it as funding stress or a ramp is contradicted by the primary document.

baseline_tension: The findings agree mildly with the slightly negative priced lean (-0.17) and with the 20-day drift (-3.8%), so they are partly in the price. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held range with an on-plan H2 narrative (as Life gave on 10-08), which would make this an 悪材料出尽くし print after a -15% Q1 already sold off. I looked for returns, a split and a buyback and found none, so the negative lean is kept small.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): cut the reported-quarter finding from -0.8 to -0.4. Belc has no 月次, so only the Q1 half of the evidence is public, and the Q2 half is a peer proxy.
Rule 1, same lesson on the scaled side: p_up moved from 43 to 45. The guidance finding (-0.5) was left standing because a forecast cut is the thing the release can ADD.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive, a held range with an 出尽くし reaction, into baseline_tension. I had already looked for returns, a split and a buyback, so p_up was not moved again for this rule.
